replication.target_description: Experiment 1: partially-overlapping t-test comparing standard AMP effects with skip-AMP effects using non-skipped trials; within-participant task manipulation, with independent standard-AMP data retained for participants lacking skip-AMP scores.

notes: Original full text not obtained: DOI/publisher landing failed or returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex list no OA location; Europe PMC lists no full text; primary-paper searches and author publication-page alternative yielded no downloadable original. No original statistics inferred from replication discussion. Replication is a conceptual replication (72 rather than 120 trials; valenced primes only), explicitly compared by its authors with original Experiment 3. Replication requested printed t statistic retained; paper also prints d = 0.96, 95% CI [0.79, 1.13], with caution about partial dependence. n = 295 is final analyzable participant sample for the partially-overlapping test, which retains standard-only scores when skip scores are unavailable. Replication title verified on author-manuscript first page; parent cached parse remains unchanged. Supplied p.7 locator corresponds to published-format results; precise locations here refer to independently retrieved author manuscript.
